cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay at the allotment until we've weighed both pumpkins. I taught you to record a crop properly; you don't leave a result to a glance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A better eye than you had when we started. Now stay to see how much bigger. Read the scale with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tell me tomorrow. I need to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow you'll question the scale. Read this number now, the way I showed you, and write it beside yours. Then you can go with the result in your own hand.

reason: Give the exact Drive a concrete request, relevant pupil habit and responsive B4 development. Improve weak endings into things A actually needs B to do, without changing playable card wording.
